verdict.rationale: Together AI publishes a per-endpoint API reference generated from its OpenAPI 3.1 document (e.g., POST /v1/chat/completions), so a structured API reference clearly exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. missing for 10: documented interactive request console/playground in the reference, runnable code examples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
